notes.title: Terry's Other Games v1.1 patch notes
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone! Got a little update for the collection ready, and here's what's in it![/p][p][/p][p] - The collection is now Steam deck verified![/p][p] - Added Japanese localisation.[/p][p] - Added Latin American Spanish localisation.[/p][p] - "Reduced Motion" accessibility option slows down or removes fast moving screen effects in most games.[/p][p] - Keyboard and Gamepad rebinding supported for all games.[/p][p] - Options menu is now accessible from the main game launcher.[/p][p] - Language selection screen is now shown on first startup.[/p][p] - Fixed a visual problem with some scenes in At a Distance.[/p][p] - Couple of other minor bug fixes.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for playing the collection, hope you've enjoyed it. All the best <3[/p][p]Terry[/p]
